title: Add pagination to data table component in TypeScript — 3 turns
description: Data table has no pagination. Add page state, prev/next navigation, and page size selector across 3 turns.

task_spec.prompt: Implement the derived state values in `usePagination` in `src/usePagination.ts`. Compute: `totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize)`, `startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize`, `endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + pageSize - 1, totalItems - 1)`, `hasPrev = currentPage > 1`, `hasNext = currentPage < totalPages`. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement the action functions: `goToPage(page)` — clamp to [1, totalPages] and call setCurrentPage. `nextPage()` — if hasNext, advance. `prevPage()` — if hasPrev, go back. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any failures.
Final step: implement `setPageSize(size)` — update pageSize state and reset currentPage to 1. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` — all 7 tests must pass.
success_criteria: nextPage and prevPage clamp to valid range
setPageSize resets to page 1 and recalculates
